name: CollegeFootballData
tagline: Comprehensive NCAA football stats, recruiting, and play-by-play data
description: CollegeFootballData provides free access to comprehensive NCAA college football statistics including games, teams, recruiting, play-by-play, ratings, and more. Self-serve API key authentication with extensive historical and current season coverage for developers building college football applications.

auth.details: API key via Bearer token or Authorization header, self-serve signup

use_cases: get NCAA football team roster and stats for a season
fetch game scores and schedules by week or team
pull recruiting rankings and player commitments
retrieve play-by-play data for a specific game
get advanced team metrics and SP+ ratings
